detailed_description: The Gauge Chart Generator creates interactive speedometer-style gauge charts in your browser using Apache ECharts. Customize current values, minimum and maximum ranges, measurement units (such as %, mph, °C, or ms), pointer visibility, progress track fills, and color gradients (Ocean, Sunset, Forest, and Default). Perfect for visualizing KPIs, performance metrics, goal completions, battery levels, and live dashboard mockups. All rendering and export (PNG/SVG) happen directly on your device with complete privacy.
usage_steps: Enter the current value and set the minimum and maximum scale bounds
Specify your custom measurement unit label (e.g., %, RPM, ms, or score)
Select a color theme gradient and toggle pointer or progress track options
Set an optional chart title and review the real-time gauge preview
Download the finished high-resolution gauge chart as PNG or SVG
usage_examples: Visualize customer satisfaction (CSAT) score on a 0 to 100 percentage dial
Display server CPU or memory utilization in a performance dashboard report
Show quarterly revenue target completion percentage for an executive slide
Create speedometer and tachometer visuals for product presentations

faqs.question: What is a gauge chart best used for?
faqs.answer: A gauge chart (or speedometer chart) is ideal for displaying a single key metric against a defined scale or target, showing immediate progress, health, or threshold status at a glance.

faqs.question: Can I set custom minimum and maximum values?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure arbitrary minimum and maximum values (e.g., 0 to 100, -50 to 50, or 0 to 1000) to fit your specific measurement scale.

faqs.question: Which export formats are supported?
faqs.answer: You can export the rendered gauge visual directly as high-resolution PNG or vector SVG format.
